name: Dexter
long_description: Dexter helps procurement teams understand exactly where money is being spent and where it can be saved. Dexter's AI agents mine supplier invoices and contracts for insights, surfacing consolidation opportunities, contract leakage, and off-contract spend.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Bella led the HubSpot automation product team, where she launched many workflow automation products in Marketing, Sales and Service Hubs. She was the Head of Product and Growth at Dance, where she scaled the member base to 10k+ and built the tools for ops. She graduated from UChicago with a BA in Economics.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Vincent has 12+ years of experience leading engineering teams.
He joined SoundCloud as the 2nd iOS engineer and worked his way to director of engineering, overseeing the media streaming, player, and core listener teams (iOS, Android, Web, Backend, C++).
As principal engineer at Dance, he worked on everything, from customer facing apps to internal web and mobile apps for the operations team.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Caterina has 10+ years of experience working in business development and operations. She was the second EMEA employee at Uber JUMP, where she launched Berlin operations and defined how markets in Europe operated. Most recently she was the Head of Operations at Dance, an ebike subscription provider, where she built the operations org from the ground up, scaling the company to +10k monthly subscribers with operations in 5 markets.
